en-US.description: KiCad fabrication tool: assign LCSC parts and export a JLCPCB order from a .kicad_pcb
en-US.name: bomexpo
en-US.releaseNotes:
Changelog
- b881cb1 feat(tui): check every part against the assembly library, and use its stock
- 84a9194 fix(export): leave vendor-drawn footprints alone and mirror bottom-side angles
- b2f2d71 feat(tui): check stock against the order size, not against zero
- fd045a9 ci: pause the winget publish while two package PRs wait in moderation
- c12c830 test(tui): drive the pad pipeline the way the runtime does
- 79e9238 fix(easyeda): cache settled geometry for a month and fetch it a few at a time
- 6b93134 fix(webjson): stop retrying a 4xx, and wait out a vendor rate limit
- 8e03f4e fix(tui): ask for the selected part's pads from one place, not every call site
- 3d116c3 fix(tui): ask for a part's pads however you arrive on its row
- 54261ce fix(kicad): catch a part too small for its land, and turn both drawings the same way
- c0b9be2 feat(tui): show the assigned part's pads under the land it sits on
- e6f7b7c feat(kicad): flag a part with more pads than the land it sits on
